set_window_title writes the OSC 0 title sequence only when is_terminal, and returns True when written and False otherwise (generated/rich/console.py:1169-1173), matching the reference contract.

Shared, non-differentiating observation: the title is interpolated without stripping ESC or BEL characters (control.py:33). A title containing \x07 or \x1b could terminate or inject sequences. The reference has the same behavior, so it does not count against the candidate, but it matters if titles come from untrusted input.
